background: Lloyds Bank plc is the main ring-fenced bank of Lloyds Banking Group, the UK's largest retail bank, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages, cards, motor finance and to UK companies.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest at A+, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is adequate, with leverage of 5.0% in the top quarter of UK majors and CET1 of 13.6% just below the peer median. Liquidity is the weak spot on paper, with LCR of 133% and NSFR of 118% both in the bottom quarter, though none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
